items.headline: Insurer incorrectly rejected the claim citing pre-existing disease waiting period.
items.explanation: The insurer rejected this claim on pre-existing disease grounds, but the patient has completed 40 months of continuous coverage, which exceeds the required waiting period. Therefore, this rejection is invalid and an appeal can recover {{flag.WAITING_REJECTION_INVALID.recoverable}}.
items.fix: File an appeal with the insurer attaching proof of continuous coverage exceeding the waiting period to overturn the rejection.
